payload.title: Resume long-running portfolio runs after application authentication expiry
payload.description:
A long-running portfolio procedure can outlive its Plexus application login. The current worker stops mid-assessment, then required artifact persistence fails with a secondary authorization error that can obscure the primary cause. Preserve the failed attempt and make recovery explicit and replay-safe.

Feature: Authentication-resilient portfolio execution

Scenario: Refresh authority during a long run
  Given a portfolio run is making durable progress
  And its application access token expires
  When the worker performs the next authorized Plexus operation
  Then it refreshes authority without losing progress
  And the same run attempt continues from durable evidence

Scenario: Resume when refresh is unavailable
  Given a portfolio run has durable ranking and partial assessment progress
  And application authority cannot be refreshed
  When an operator reauthenticates and resumes the procedure
  Then completed durable work is not silently discarded
  And the same attempt resumes from the latest valid checkpoint
  And no optimizer target is dispatched twice

Scenario: Preserve the primary failure
  Given application authentication expires during execution
  When terminal artifact persistence also lacks authority
  Then the run reports authentication expiry as the primary failure
  And artifact persistence failure remains visible as a secondary failure

Out of scope: weakening artifact authorization, persisting credentials in procedure state, or automatically promoting score versions.
